task: Rank a fixed gallery of recorded clips for each independently written description. The correct exact target is the recording the annotator described.
preprocessing: ASCII English words and numbers, lowercased. Clip-level training document frequency; highest frequency first, lexical tie-break. Padding and unknown tokens separate. IDF-weighted counts and L2 scaling for ridge. Fit population mean and standard deviation across training clips and 24 frames. Use scale 1 for channels with standard deviation <= 1e-6.
baseline: Predict each recording's standardized trajectory mean, population standard deviation, average absolute adjacent step and final minus initial value. Fit a multioutput ridge with unpenalized intercept, one unit of total weight per source recording. Compare predicted and measured descriptors by cosine.
attention: A word embedding and a linear motion projection feed separate one-block self-attention stacks with learned positions, four heads, GELU, pre-layer normalization, masked temporal mean and a normalized projection. No dropout or pretraining. One random caption per recording per epoch; same motion permutation and caption draws in both model fits. Symmetric cross entropy in both directions. Final epoch only.
negative_control: Fit the identical attention model after assigning each training recording's entire caption group to a different recording via one seeded random cycle. Assessment always uses genuine recording correspondences.
metrics: Top-1 and top-5 recall plus expected reciprocal rank. Uniform tie order, equal weight per caption within recording, then equal per recording. Also report equal-weight group summaries. The full assessment gallery is fixed by the metadata seal.
main_comparison: Descriptive exploratory signal criterion only: the attention model must exceed chance, wrong-pair and ridge in motion-macro recall@1 and MRR on the full fixed gallery. Where a grounded caption-to-action baseline exists it must also exceed that baseline on both measures. Disclose every per-group result. No population significance or causal inference.
ambiguity: If all gallery clips carry a source action label, report predicted action-class similarity and a privileged oracle given the query and gallery actions. Report same-action top-1 compatibility, plus exact retrieval among gallery clips carrying that same action (exclude singleton classes and give counts). Otherwise report lexical collisions and explicitly keep unknown semantic equivalences unresolved.
data_access: Group before payload inspection. Freeze manifest, source inventory and policy before assessment. Lock scripts, preprocessing, fit and training evidence before assessment. Reserve has no admissible payload read path. Record quantitative diagnostics once; do not use the assessment to select a new representation.
additional_retrieval: Also report the first matching recording when multiple gallery recordings have the identically tokenized complete description, and reverse retrieval of any genuine caption attached to each gallery recording. Positive ties use their full permutation distribution. These secondary metrics do not judge unseen paraphrases.
